en.understanding: This verse introduces Jesus as "the Word," a powerful idea for both Jews and Greeks at that time. It tells us that Jesus wasn't created; He has existed with God from the very beginning. John makes it absolutely clear: Jesus is not just a messenger *from* God, He fully *is* God.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus is the eternal Word of God, His teachings are not just good suggestions; they are life-giving truth. When we read the Gospels, let's remember we are reading the very words of God Himself. This should inspire us to listen carefully and obey what He says with reverence and trust.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that the eternal God did not want to remain a distant mystery? He revealed Himself to us personally through Jesus, the Word who became flesh. This shows God's deep desire to be known by us and to have a close relationship with us.
en.reflection: How does knowing that Jesus is fully God, and not just a good teacher, change the way you listen to His words and approach Him in prayer?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakilala sa talatang ito si Jesus bilang "ang Salita" o "the Word," na isang malalim na konsepto para sa mga Judio at Griyego noon. Sinasabi dito na hindi Siya nilikha; kasama na Niya ang Diyos mula pa sa simula. Malinaw ang punto ni John: si Jesus ay hindi lang *galing* sa Diyos, Siya mismo *ay* Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Jesus ang mismong Salita ng Diyos, ang Kanyang mga turo ay hindi lang magagandang payo—ito ay katotohanang nagbibigay-buhay. Kapag binabasa natin ang Bibliya, alalahanin nating salita mismo ng Diyos ang ating naririnig. Magsilbi sana itong inspirasyon para pakinggan natin Siya nang mabuti at sundin Siya nang may paggalang at tiwala.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya nais manatiling isang hiwaga sa atin. Ipinakilala Niya ang Kanyang sarili sa personal na paraan sa pamamagitan ni Jesus, ang Salitang naging tao. Pinapakita nito kung gaano Niya tayo kamahal at kung gaano Niya ninanais na makilala natin Siya nang malapitan.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalaman na si Jesus ay Diyos (at hindi lang isang mabuting guro) ang paraan ng iyong pakikinig sa Kanyang mga salita at pakikipag-usap sa Kanya?

en.understanding: The opening of John's book, where this verse is found, reads like a beautiful song or poem used by the first Christians. It introduces us to the big ideas of the whole story that is about to unfold. It prepares our hearts to see Jesus as the Light who brings the gift of new life.
en.livingItOut: Just as this verse sets the stage for the story of Jesus, we can let Jesus set the tone for our day. When we start our morning with Him in prayer or by reading His Word, we invite the One who was there "in the beginning" to be at the center of our story today.
en.godsLove: God’s love for you was not a last-minute decision or a "Plan B." This verse shows us that Jesus, the ultimate expression of God's love, was with the Father from the very start. His plan to reach out to you in love is as old as eternity itself.
en.reflection: How does it give you confidence today to know that Jesus was part of God's loving plan for you before your life even began?

tl.understanding: Ang simula ng aklat ni John, kung saan galing ang talatang ito, ay parang isang magandang awit na kinakanta ng mga unang Kristiyano. Inihahanda nito ang ating mga puso para sa buong kwento ni Jesus. Ipinapakilala nito si Jesus bilang Ilaw na nagbibigay ng bagong buhay.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong inihanda ng talatang ito ang kwento ni Jesus, hayaan din nating si Jesus ang magtakda ng takbo ng ating araw. Kapag sinimulan natin ang umaga kasama Siya sa panalangin, inaanyayahan natin ang Diyos na Siyang "nasa simula pa" na maging sentro ng kwento natin ngayon.
tl.godsLove: Hindi "Plan B" o biglaang desisyon lang ng Diyos ang pagmamahal Niya sa iyo. Ipinapakita ng talatang ito na si Jesus, ang sukdulang patunay ng pag-ibig ng Diyos, ay kasama na ng Ama mula pa sa simula. Ang Kanyang plano na mahalin ka ay kasing-tanda na ng panahon.
tl.reflection: Paano nagbibigay sa iyo ng lakas ng loob ngayon ang kaalaman na si Jesus ay bahagi na ng mapagmahal na plano ng Diyos para sa'yo bago ka pa man isilang?

en.understanding: This verse reveals that Jesus is the Creator of everything we see. The Tyndale note highlights that because Jesus is God (the "Logos" or Word), His work in creation is God's own divine work in action. Nothing exists that He did not make.
en.livingItOut: When you feel overwhelmed, step outside and look at the sky or a simple flower. Remember that the same powerful Jesus who created the universe is also personally involved in the details of your life, and you can trust Him with it all.
en.godsLove: God's love is so deep that the very One who created the entire universe chose to step into it for our sake. The Creator became part of His creation, all to rescue us and bring us back to Himself. What an incredible, personal love!
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to be reminded that Jesus, the Creator of all things, has the power to work?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito na si Jesus ang Lumikha ng lahat ng bagay. Sinasabi sa atin na dahil si Jesus ay Diyos (ang "Logos" o Salita), ang Kanyang paglikha sa sanlibutan ay gawa mismo ng Diyos. Walang anumang bagay na umiral na hindi Niya ginawa.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag feeling mo na-o-overwhelm ka, lumabas ka sandali at tumingin sa langit o sa isang bulaklak. Alalahanin mo na ang makapangyarihang Hesus na lumikha niyan ay Siya ring may pakialam sa bawat detalye ng buhay mo, kaya't maaari kang magtiwala sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; ang mismong Lumikha ng buong sanlibutan ay piniling pumasok dito para sa atin. Ang Creator ay naging bahagi ng Kanyang creation para iligtas tayo at ibalik sa Kanya. Ganyan ka-personal ang pagmamahal Niya sa'yo!
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong maalala na si Hesus, ang Lumikha ng lahat, ay may kapangyarihang kumilos?

en.understanding: This verse tells us that Jesus is the very source of life, going all the way back to creation. But He offers more than just physical life; He gives us a brand new spiritual life, which acts like a light to guide us out of darkness. Jesus is offering us a spiritual "re-creation" and a fresh start.
en.livingItOut: Because Jesus is our light, we don't have to walk around in spiritual darkness or confusion anymore. Let's allow His life to shine through our actions and decisions today. In moments of uncertainty, we can pause and ask, "Lord, what is the path of light here?"
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that God's love doesn't just rescue us *from* darkness, but gives us *something* beautiful—a new life? He loves us so much that He didn't want us to be lost. He sent Jesus to be our constant source of life and our guiding light home.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life—a relationship, a decision, or a worry—do you need to invite the light of Jesus to shine today?

tl.understanding: Sinasabi rito na si Hesus mismo ang pinagmumulan ng buhay, mula pa noong umpisa ng paglikha. Pero higit pa sa pisikal na buhay, nag-aalok Siya ng isang bago at espirituwal na buhay. Ang buhay na ito ay parang ilaw na gumagabay sa atin para makaalis sa kadiliman.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Hesus ang ating ilaw, hindi na natin kailangang manatili sa kadiliman ng takot o pagkalito. Hayaan nating ang Kanyang liwanag ang maging gabay sa ating mga desisyon at pakikitungo sa iba ngayong araw. Sa mga pagkakataong hindi tayo sigurado, huminto tayo at manalangin, "Panginoon, ano po ang landas ng liwanag dito?"
tl.godsLove: Nakakamangha ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi lang Niya tayo iniligtas *mula* sa kadiliman, kundi binigyan din Niya tayo *ng* isang napakagandang bagong buhay. Mahal na mahal Niya tayo at ayaw Niyang tayo'y maligaw, kaya isinugo Niya si Hesus upang maging ating buhay at liwanag na gabay.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng iyong buhay—sa isang relasyon, desisyon, o alalahanin—ang kailangan mong anyayahan ang liwanag ni Hesus na magbigay-gabay ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse is a powerful promise. The "darkness" wasn't just confused; it was actively hostile and tried to destroy Jesus, the Light. But no matter how hard it tried, it could never put out His light.
en.livingItOut: When you face your own 'dark' moments—like worry, sadness, or sin—remember this truth. Invite Jesus, the Light, into that situation, knowing that His presence is more powerful than any darkness you're facing.
en.godsLove: God's love is so great that He didn't abandon us to the darkness. He sent His own Son, Jesus, as a powerful, unstoppable Light to rescue us. This victory wasn't for Himself, but for you.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to invite Jesus' unconquerable light to shine today?

tl.understanding: Ang talatang ito ay isang napakatibay na pangako. Ang 'kadiliman' dito ay hindi lang basta hindi nakaunawa; ito'y aktibong kumalaban at sinubukang wasakin si Hesus, ang Ilaw. Pero kahit anong gawin nito, hinding-hindi nito kayang patayin ang Kanyang liwanag.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag dumadaan ka sa mga 'madilim' na sandali—tulad ng pag-aalala, kalungkutan, o kasalanan—alalahanin mo ang katotohanang ito. Anyayahan mo si Hesus, ang Ilaw, sa sitwasyong iyan, dahil ang Kanyang presensya ay mas makapangyarihan kaysa anumang dilim na iyong hinaharap.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya tayo pinabayaan sa kadiliman. Ipinadala Niya ang Kanyang Anak, si Hesus, bilang isang makapangyarihan at di-mapipigilang Ilaw para iligtas tayo. Ang tagumpay na ito ay hindi para sa Kanya, kundi para sa iyo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong anyayahan ang hindi matatalong liwanag ni Hesus?

en.understanding: The Gospel of John starts by preparing our hearts for Jesus' arrival. John the Baptist wasn't just a random person; he was a real man with a special mission directly from God. His entire purpose was to act as an announcer, getting people ready to meet the true Light of the World.
en.livingItOut: Just as God sent John with a purpose, He sends you with one, too. Your mission is to point others to Jesus in your own unique way, through your words and your actions. In your family, work, or community, be a signpost that lovingly leads people to Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so thoughtful and detailed. He didn't just send His Son into the world unannounced; He first sent a messenger to prepare the way and get everyone's attention. He lovingly makes sure we have every opportunity to see and receive Jesus.
en.reflection: Who is one person in your life God might be asking you to gently point toward Jesus this week?

tl.understanding: Inihahanda tayo ng Ebanghelyo ni Juan para sa pagdating ni Jesus. Si Juan Bautista ay hindi lang basta kung sino; siya ay isang totoong tao na may espesyal na misyon mula mismo sa Diyos. Ang buong layunin niya ay maging tagapagpakilala, para ihanda ang mga tao na salubungin ang tunay na Ilaw ng sanlibutan.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong isinugo ng Diyos si Juan na may layunin, isinusugo ka rin Niya na may purpose. Ang misyon mo ay ituro sa iba ang daan patungo kay Jesus sa iyong sariling paraan, sa salita at sa gawa. Sa iyong pamilya, trabaho, o komunidad, maging isang "signpost" ka na nagtuturo sa mga tao kung nasaan si Kristo.
tl.godsLove: Napaka-maalalahanin at detalyado ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya basta na lang isinugo ang Kanyang Anak; nagpadala muna Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang daan at makuha ang ating atensyon. Tinitiyak Niyang mayroon tayong lahat ng pagkakataon na makita at tanggapin si Jesus.
tl.reflection: Sino ang isang tao sa buhay mo na marahil ay nais ng Diyos na dahan-dahan mong ituro patungo kay Jesus sa linggong ito?

en.understanding: The beginning of John's gospel is like a beautiful song about Jesus being the Light of the world. In this verse, John the Baptist isn't the Light himself, but he's like a spotlight operator. His whole purpose was to point everyone to the main star—Jesus—so they could believe in Him.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our lives are meant to point others to Jesus. We don't have to be the source of light, but we can reflect His light to our family, friends, and co-workers through our kindness and our story. Let your life be a sign that points to Him.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so great that He didn't just send the Light; He also sent a messenger to make sure we wouldn't miss it! He loves people so much that He makes the way clear for them to find Jesus and believe. He truly desires for everyone to come to Him.
en.reflection: In what simple way can my life serve as a "spotlight," pointing someone I know toward the love and light of Jesus this week?

tl.understanding: Ang simula ng aklat ni Juan ay parang isang magandang awit tungkol kay Hesus bilang Ilaw ng sanlibutan. Sa talatang ito, si John the Baptist ay hindi ang Ilaw, pero siya ay parang taga-hawak ng spotlight. Ang tanging layunin niya ay ituro ang lahat sa tunay na Bida—si Hesus—upang sila ay maniwala.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John the Baptist, ang buhay natin ay dapat maging direksyon na nagtuturo sa iba papunta kay Hesus. Hindi kailangang tayo ang maging ilaw, pero kaya nating ipakita ang Kanyang liwanag sa ating pamilya, kaibigan, at katrabaho sa pamamagitan ng ating kabaitan at kwento. Hayaan mong maging sign post ang buhay mo patungo sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi lang Niya ipinadala ang Ilaw, nagpadala pa Siya ng mensahero para siguradohing makikita natin ito! Mahal na mahal Niya ang mga tao kaya ginagawa Niyang malinaw ang daan para matagpuan nila si Hesus at manampalataya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong simpleng paraan pwedeng maging "spotlight" ang buhay ko para maituro ang isang kakilala ko sa pag-ibig at liwanag ni Hesus ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse makes it clear that John the Baptist was not the Messiah, even though some people thought he was. His God-given role was incredibly important: to be a witness who pointed everyone to Jesus, the one true Light. John was the signpost, but Jesus was the destination.
en.livingItOut: Like John, our lives have a beautiful purpose: to point others to Jesus. Instead of seeking attention for ourselves, let's use our words and actions to show others how wonderful He is. Our lives can be a testimony that directs people to the real source of hope and salvation.
en.godsLove: God's love is so thoughtful. He didn't just send Jesus into the world; He lovingly sent a messenger first to prepare everyone's hearts. This shows how much He wants us to find and know Jesus, the true Light of our lives.
en.reflection: In what small way can your life be a signpost that points someone toward Jesus's love and light this week?

tl.understanding: Nililinaw ng talatang ito na si John the Baptist ay hindi ang Tagapagligtas, kahit iyon ang akala ng iba. Napakahalaga ng kanyang misyon mula sa Diyos: ang maging saksi na nagtuturo sa lahat patungo kay Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw. Si John ang "signpost," pero si Hesus ang destinasyon.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John, may magandang misyon din ang buhay natin: ang ituro ang iba kay Hesus. Sa halip na tayo ang maging bida, gamitin natin ang ating salita at gawa para ipakita sa iba kung gaano kabuti ang Panginoon. Ang buhay natin ay pwedeng maging patotoo na nagdidirekta sa mga tao sa tunay na pag-asa.
tl.godsLove: Napakamaalalahanin ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya lang basta isinugo si Hesus; nagpadala muna Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang puso ng lahat. Pinapakita nito kung gaano Niya ninanais na makilala natin si Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw ng ating buhay.
tl.reflection: Sa anong maliit na paraan pwedeng maging isang "signpost" ang buhay mo para maituro ang isang tao sa pag-ibig at liwanag ni Hesus ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse is part of the beautiful opening of John's book, like an introduction or a song. It sets the stage for the whole story by telling us that Jesus, the true Light, was coming into our dark world. This light of hope and truth was made available for every single person.
en.livingItOut: Today, when you feel lost or confused, remember that Jesus is your Light. Instead of staying in the dark with your worries, intentionally turn to Him in prayer. Ask Him to shine on your situation and show you the next right step to take.
en.godsLove: God's love is so immense that He didn't leave us alone in the darkness of sin and confusion. He lovingly sent His Son, Jesus, to be a light for *every* person, including you. This shows He desires for no one to be lost, but for all to find their way to Him.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need Jesus, the true Light, to shine His wisdom and hope today?

tl.understanding: Ang talatang ito ay parang isang magandang introduction sa aklat ni Juan. Ipinapakilala nito ang pinaka-tema: si Hesus, ang totoong Ilaw, ay paparating sa ating madilim na mundo. Ang liwanag na ito ng pag-asa at katotohanan ay para sa bawat tao.
tl.livingItOut: Ngayong araw, kung pakiramdam mo ay nalilito ka o nawawala, alalahanin mong si Hesus ang iyong Ilaw. Sa halip na manatili sa dilim ng pag-aalala, sadyain mong lumapit sa Kanya sa panalangin at hilingin na bigyan Niya ng linaw ang sitwasyon mo.
tl.godsLove: Ganun na lang kalaki ang pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya hindi Niya tayo hinayaang mag-isa sa dilim ng kasalanan at kalituhan. Buong pagmamahal Niyang sinugo ang Kanyang Anak na si Hesus para maging ilaw sa bawat tao—kasama ka na roon. Nais Niyang lahat tayo ay makahanap ng daan pabalik sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong ipasikat ni Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw, ang Kanyang karunungan at pag-asa?

en.understanding: Jesus, the Creator, came to live in the very world He made, but people didn't recognize Him. This wasn't just a simple mistake; it was because people's hearts preferred living in the darkness of sin rather than stepping into God's light. They were standing face-to-face with their Maker but were spiritually blind to who He was.
en.livingItOut: In our busy lives, we can also fail to recognize Jesus' work around us. Today, let's pause and intentionally look for Him—in a kind word from a friend, in the beauty of creation, or in His quiet guidance during a tough decision. Let's not be too distracted by the world to see our Creator at work.
en.godsLove: God's love is so amazing that He sent Jesus, knowing He would be rejected by the very people He came to save. He didn't wait for us to look for Him; He stepped into our darkness to pursue us. This shows a love that is willing to be misunderstood just to be near us.
en.reflection: In what area of my life do I need to ask God to open my eyes, so I can see and recognize Him more clearly?

tl.understanding: Si Hesus ang gumawa ng mundo, pero nang Siya ay naparito, hindi Siya nakilala ng mga tao. Hindi ito simpleng pagkakamali; ito ay dahil mas pinili ng puso ng mga tao na mamuhay sa kadiliman ng kasalanan kaysa sa liwanag ng Diyos. Kaharap na nila ang kanilang Manlilikha, pero bulag ang kanilang espiritu para makilala Siya.
tl.livingItOut: Sa ating abalang buhay, maaari din nating hindi mapansin ang pagkilos ni Hesus sa paligid natin. Ngayong araw, huminto tayo sandali at sadyain nating hanapin Siya—sa isang mabuting salita mula sa kaibigan, sa ganda ng kalikasan, o sa Kanyang tahimik na paggabay. Huwag tayong maging masyadong abala sa mundo para hindi makita ang ating Creator.
tl.godsLove: Kahanga-hanga ang pag-ibig ng Diyos, dahil isinugo Niya si Hesus kahit alam Niyang hindi Siya tatanggapin ng mga taong nais Niyang iligtas. Hindi Niya hinintay na hanapin natin Siya; Siya mismo ang pumasok sa ating kadiliman para habulin tayo. Ito ang pag-ibig na handang masaktan, mapalapit lang sa atin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako dapat humingi ng tulong sa Diyos para buksan ang aking mga mata, para mas makita at makilala ko Siya nang malinaw?

en.understanding: The book of John prepares us from the start for a tough reality: Jesus, the light of the world, came to His very own people, but many of them turned away from Him. This theme of being rejected, even by those He came to save, is a central part of His story on earth.
en.livingItOut: While many rejected Jesus then, we have the beautiful choice to receive Him today. We can do this by intentionally welcoming His presence and guidance in our daily decisions, whether they feel big or small. Let's make our hearts a place where He is always welcome.
en.godsLove: God's love is so powerful that He sent Jesus, knowing full well that many would not accept Him. He took the ultimate risk of rejection just for the chance to offer us salvation. This shows a love that pursues us first, not waiting for us to deserve it.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life today can you intentionally welcome Jesus' presence and guidance?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita agad sa simula ng aklat ni Juan ang isang masakit na katotohanan: si Hesus, ang ilaw ng sanlibutan, ay pumarito para sa sarili Niyang bayan, pero marami sa kanila ang tumalikod sa Kanya. Ang pagtangging ito ay isang mahalagang bahagi ng Kanyang kwento dito sa lupa.
tl.livingItOut: Kahit marami ang tumanggi kay Hesus noon, mayroon tayong magandang pagkakataon na tanggapin Siya ngayon. Magagawa natin ito sa sadyang pag-welcome sa Kanyang presensya at gabay sa ating mga desisyon araw-araw, maliit man o malaki. Gawin nating isang lugar ang ating puso kung saan Siya ay laging welcome.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya't sinugo Niya si Hesus kahit alam Niyang marami ang hindi tatanggap sa Kanya. Isinugal Niya ang lahat, kahit pa ang matanggihan, para lang mabigyan tayo ng pagkakataong maligtas. Ito ay pag-ibig na unang lumalapit sa atin, hindi naghihintay na maging karapat-dapat tayo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular na bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon maaari mong sadyain na i-welcome ang presensya at gabay ni Hesus?

en.understanding: This verse explains the amazing way we join God's family. It's not something we earn or are born into naturally; it's a supernatural gift from God. Our part is simply to believe in Jesus and welcome Him into our lives.
en.livingItOut: Let this truth change how you see yourself today: you are a child of God! Walk with confidence, not in your own strength, but in your identity as a loved and accepted member of His family. This means you are never alone and always have a place to belong.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so personal that He doesn't just save us; He adopts us. He actively gives us the "right" to be His children, eagerly welcoming us into the most important family in the universe. He doesn't just want followers; He wants sons and daughters.
en.reflection: How does knowing you are a beloved child of God change the way you talk to Him in prayer today?

tl.understanding: Ipinaliliwanag dito ang paraan para maging parte tayo ng pamilya ng Diyos. Hindi ito isang bagay na pinaghihirapan o automatic nating nakukuha; isa itong supernatural na regalo mula sa Kanya. Ang ating parte ay ang maniwala at tanggapin si Hesus sa ating buhay.
tl.livingItOut: Hayaan mong baguhin nito ang tingin mo sa sarili mo ngayon: isa kang anak ng Diyos! Lumakad ka nang may kumpiyansa, hindi dahil sa sarili mong lakas, kundi dahil sa katotohanang ikaw ay minamahal at tinanggap na miyembro ng Kanyang pamilya. Ibig sabihin, hindi ka nag-iisa at palagi kang mayroong tahanan.
tl.godsLove: Napakapersonal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi lang Niya tayo inililigtas, inaampon pa Niya tayo. Ibinibigay Niya sa atin ang "karapatan" na maging Kanyang mga anak, at masaya Niya tayong tinatanggap sa pinaka-importanteng pamilya sa buong mundo. Hindi lang Siya naghahanap ng tagasunod; gusto Niya ng mga anak.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalaman na ikaw ay isang minamahal na anak ng Diyos ang paraan ng pakikipag-usap mo sa Kanya sa panalangin ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse reminds us that becoming a child of God isn't about our family background or our own efforts. It is a spiritual rebirth that only God can perform. Through His amazing grace, He brings us out of spiritual darkness and welcomes us into His family.
en.livingItOut: Today, let's live with a heart full of gratitude, knowing our place in God's family is a pure gift. Instead of trying to earn His love, we can simply rest in the truth that He chose us. This frees us from pressure and allows us to enjoy our relationship with Him.
en.godsLove: See how personal God's love is! He didn't wait for us to find Him; He actively reached out to make us His own children. This isn't a distant relationship—it's a loving family invitation, initiated by His own heart.
en.reflection: How does knowing your relationship with God is a pure gift, not something you earned, change the way you talk to Him today?

tl.understanding: Sinasabi dito na ang pagiging anak ng Diyos ay hindi dahil sa ating lahi o sariling kakayahan. Ito ay isang spiritual rebirth na galing mismo sa Diyos. Sa pamamagitan ng Kanyang biyaya, inililigtas Niya tayo mula sa kadiliman at ginagawang parte ng Kanyang pamilya.
tl.livingItOut: Ngayong araw, mamuhay tayo nang may pusong puno ng pasasalamat, dahil alam nating ang ating pwesto sa pamilya ng Diyos ay isang regalo. Sa halip na piliting i-earn ang Kanyang pagmamahal, pwede tayong maging panatag dahil Siya ang pumili sa atin. Pinalalaya tayo nito mula sa pressure para mas ma-enjoy natin ang ating relasyon sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Tingnan mo kung gaano ka-personal ang pag-ibig ng Diyos! Hindi Siya naghintay na hanapin natin Siya; Siya mismo ang kumilos para gawin tayong mga anak Niya. Hindi ito isang malayong relasyon—ito ay isang imbitasyon sa Kanyang pamilya, na nagmula mismo sa Kanyang pusong mapagmahal.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalaman na ang relasyon mo sa Diyos ay isang regalo at hindi mo pinaghirapan, ang paraan ng pakikipag-usap mo sa Kanya ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse tells us that Jesus, who is the eternal Word of God, became a real human being. The phrase "made His dwelling" literally means He "pitched His tent" among us. This reminds us of the Old Testament Tabernacle where God's glorious presence lived with His people; now, God's glorious presence is with us in Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus didn't stay distant but came close to us in our messy world, let's follow His example. We can choose to move closer to people who are struggling or feel alone, offering them our friendship and a listening ear instead of judging from afar.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He didn't just send a message from heaven; He came Himself in the person of Jesus. He chose to experience our life, our joys, and our pains to show us He truly understands and is with us. This is the ultimate act of empathy and love.
en.reflection: In what area of your life today do you need to remember that Jesus, "full of grace and truth," is dwelling right there with you?

tl.understanding: Ang ibig sabihin ng talatang ito, si Hesus na Salita ng Diyos ay naging isang tunay na tao. Ang Kanyang "paninirahan" sa piling natin ay parang pagtatayo ng Kanyang tolda, na nagpapaalala sa atin ng Tabernakulo kung saan nanahan ang Diyos kasama ang Kanyang bayan. Ngayon, si Hesus ang presensya ng Diyos na malapit at kasama natin.
tl.livingItOut: Kung si Hesus ay hindi nanatiling malayo at piniling pumasok sa ating magulong mundo, tularan natin Siya. Piliin nating lumapit sa mga taong nahihirapan o nalulungkot, at ialok sa kanila ang ating pakikinig at pagkakaibigan sa halip na husgahan sila.
tl.godsLove: Napakalaki ng pag-ibig ng Diyos na hindi lang Siya nagpadala ng mensahe; Siya mismo ang pumarito sa katauhan ni Hesus. Pinili Niyang maranasan ang ating buhay, saya, at sakit para ipakita sa atin na naiintindihan Niya tayo at kasama natin Siya. Ito ang sukdulang pagpapakita ng Kanyang pagmamahal at pakikiramay.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ang kailangan mong alalahanin na si Hesus, na "puno ng biyaya at katotohanan," ay nananahang kasama mo?

en.understanding: In their culture, being older meant you were more honored. So when John the Baptist said Jesus "was before me," it was a powerful statement. He was declaring that Jesus is not just an ordinary man but the eternal God who existed long before creation.
en.livingItOut: Just as John pointed others to Jesus' greatness, we can do the same. In our conversations and actions today, let's look for opportunities to honor Jesus above ourselves. Let's make Him the hero of our story, not us.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that the eternal God, who is far greater than anyone, chose to become human for us? He humbled Himself to come to earth, stepping into our world to show us the way back to the Father. This reveals His incredible, self-giving love.
en.reflection: In what specific area of my life can I give Jesus more honor this week?

tl.understanding: Sa kultura nila noon, mas iginagalang ang mga nakatatanda. Kaya nung sinabi ni John the Baptist na si Jesus ay "nauna sa kanya," isa itong makapangyarihang pagpapahayag na si Jesus ay hindi lang tao, kundi ang walang hanggang Diyos na umiiral na bago pa man ang lahat.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John na itinuro ang kadakilaan ni Jesus, ganoon din sana tayo. Sa ating mga kilos at salita ngayon, hanapin natin ang pagkakataong bigyan ng karangalan si Jesus nang higit sa ating sarili. Gawin natin Siyang Bida ng kwento ng ating buhay.
tl.godsLove: Nakakabilib isipin na ang Diyos na umiiral bago pa ang lahat ay piniling maging tao para sa atin. Nagpakumbaba Siya at pumasok sa ating mundo para iligtas tayo. Ipinapakita nito ang hindi masukat na pag-ibig at sakripisyo ng Diyos para sa iyo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular na bahagi ng buhay ko ako mas makakapagbigay ng karangalan kay Hesus ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This beautiful verse is part of the introduction to John's Gospel, which many believe was an early Christian hymn celebrating Jesus. It sets the stage for the whole book by announcing the greatest news: Jesus came to give believers the gift of new life through His unending grace.
en.livingItOut: Because God's grace for you never runs out, you can stop striving to be perfect just to earn His love. Instead, rest in His complete acceptance and let that overflow by showing grace and patience to others, even when they don't deserve it.
en.godsLove: God's love isn't a small cup of water; it's an overflowing ocean. He doesn't just give us *enough* grace for today, He gives us "grace upon grace"—more than we could ever need or imagine. This shows His incredibly generous heart that loves to bless His children abundantly.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life do you need to stop trying in your own strength and start receiving His "grace upon grace"?

tl.understanding: Ang talatang ito ay bahagi ng panimula ng aklat ni Juan, na posibleng isang sinaunang awit ng papuri para kay Hesus. Ipinapakilala nito ang pinakamagandang balita sa buong libro: dumating si Hesus para bigyan tayo ng bagong buhay sa pamamagitan ng Kanyang walang katapusang biyaya.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil hindi nauubos ang biyaya ng Diyos para sa'yo, hindi mo na kailangang magpakapagod para maging perpekto at makuha ang pag-ibig Niya. Magpahinga ka sa Kanyang lubos na pagtanggap, at hayaan mong umapaw ito sa pamamagitan ng pagpapakita ng biyaya at pasensya sa iba.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay hindi isang maliit na baso lang, kundi isang karagatang umaapaw. Hindi lang sapat na biyaya ang binibigay Niya, kundi "biyaya sa ibabaw ng biyaya"—higit pa sa ating kailangan o inaakala. Pinapakita nito ang Kanyang pusong mapagbigay na nagagalak na pagpalain ang Kanyang mga anak.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong tumigil sa pag-asa sa sarili mong lakas at simulang tanggapin ang Kanyang "biyaya sa ibabaw ng biyaya"?

en.understanding: The Law that God gave through Moses was good and showed us glimpses of His character. But in Jesus, we see the full, perfect picture of God's grace and truth. He is the ultimate revelation of who God is.
en.livingItOut: Instead of trying to earn God's favor by perfectly following rules, let's rest in the grace Jesus offers. We can approach God with confidence, not because we are perfect, but because Jesus is.
en.godsLove: God knew the Law would show us our need for a Savior, but He didn't stop there. His love is so great that He sent Jesus to be the answer, showering us with grace and truth we could never earn. He wants a relationship with us, not just our obedience to rules.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to stop trying to "be good enough" for God and simply receive the grace and truth that Jesus offers?

tl.understanding: Ang Kautusan na binigay ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ni Moses ay mabuti at nagpakita ng sulyap sa Kanyang pagkatao. Pero kay Hesus, nakikita natin ang buo at perpektong larawan ng biyaya at katotohanan ng Diyos. Siya ang pinakaganap na pagpapakilala kung sino ang Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Sa halip na piliting makuha ang pabor ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa mga rules, magpahinga tayo sa biyayang bigay ni Hesus. Pwede tayong lumapit sa Diyos nang may tiwala, hindi dahil perpekto tayo, kundi dahil si Hesus ang ating Daan.
tl.godsLove: Alam ng Diyos na ipapakita ng Kautusan na kailangan natin ng Tagapagligtas, at hindi Siya tumigil doon. Napakalaki ng pag-ibig Niya kaya't sinugo Niya si Hesus para maging sagot, at binuhos sa atin ang biyaya at katotohanang hinding-hindi natin kayang makuha mag-isa. Nais Niya ng relasyon sa atin, hindi lang basta pagsunod.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo kailangan mong itigil ang pagsisikap na maging "good enough" para sa Diyos, at sa halip ay tanggapin na lang ang biyaya at katotohanang bigay ni Hesus?

en.understanding: No one in all of history has ever been able to see God the Father face-to-face. But because Jesus is God Himself and has always been with the Father, He is the perfect one to show us exactly what God is like. Jesus makes the invisible God visible to us.
en.livingItOut: If you want to know what God is really like—how He thinks, feels, and acts—simply look at Jesus. Spend time reading the Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, John) and watch how Jesus loved people, taught with patience, and showed compassion.
en.godsLove: God knew we could never fully understand Him on our own, so in His great love, He came down to us. He sent Jesus not just as a messenger with information, but as the perfect picture of His own heart so we could know Him personally.
en.reflection: As you look at the life of Jesus, what is one new thing you are learning about the Father's character?

tl.understanding: Wala pang sinuman ang direktang nakakita sa Diyos Ama. Pero dahil si Hesus ay Diyos din at laging kapiling ng Ama, Siya ang perpektong nagpakilala sa atin kung sino talaga ang Diyos. Ginawa ni Hesus na makita natin ang Diyos na hindi nakikita.
tl.livingItOut: Kung gusto mong malaman kung ano talaga ang ugali ng Diyos—paano Siya mag-isip at magmahal—tingnan mo lang si Hesus. Maglaan ka ng oras na basahin ang Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, John) at pansinin kung paano nagmahal ng tao si Hesus at naging mapagpasensya.
tl.godsLove: Alam ng Diyos na hindi natin Siya kayang lubusang unawain, kaya dahil sa laki ng Kanyang pag-ibig, Siya mismo ang lumapit sa atin. Ipinadala Niya si Hesus hindi lang bilang mensahero, kundi bilang buhay na larawan ng Kanyang puso para personal natin Siyang makilala.
tl.reflection: Habang tinitingnan mo ang buhay ni Hesus, anong bagong bagay ang natututunan mo tungkol sa pagkatao at puso ng ating Ama sa langit?

en.understanding: This verse kicks off a major theme in John's Gospel: Jesus' arrival makes people choose a side. The religious leaders in Jerusalem were already investigating, starting with John the Baptist. This shows that right from the start, people had to decide whether to believe or not.
en.livingItOut: Like the people in Jesus' time, we face a choice about Him every day. Let's not just be passive listeners, but actively decide to follow Jesus in our words and actions. Our daily choices become our testimony about who He is.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and kind. He doesn't force anyone to believe, but instead sends messengers and gives evidence so we can choose Him for ourselves. This loving invitation to believe is one of the greatest expressions of His heart for us.
en.reflection: When people see your life, what does your testimony say about who Jesus is to you?

tl.understanding: Dito sa verse na ito nagsisimula ang isang mahalagang tema sa aklat ni Juan: kapag dumating si Hesus, kailangan mong mamili. Nagsimula na ang pag-uusisa ng mga religious leaders, at inuna nila si John the Baptist. Ipinapakita nito na mula't mula pa, ang pagpapakilala kay Hesus ay humihingi ng desisyon—maniniwala ka ba o hindi?
tl.livingItOut: Katulad ng mga tao noon, hinaharap din natin ang tanong kung sino si Hesus para sa atin. Huwag lang tayong manatiling tagapakinig; piliin nating isabuhay ang ating pananampalataya sa Kanya sa ating mga desisyon at pakikitungo sa iba araw-araw.
tl.godsLove: Makikita natin dito ang pasensya at kabutihan ng Diyos. Hindi Niya tayo pinipilit na maniwala, bagkus ay nagbibigay Siya ng mga patotoo para malaya natin Siyang mapili. Ang imbitasyong ito na manalig sa Kanya ay isang napakagandang regalo ng Kanyang pag-ibig.
tl.reflection: Sa paraan ng iyong pamumuhay, anong patotoo ang naipapakita mo sa iba tungkol sa kung sino si Hesus para sa'yo?

en.understanding: During that time, the Jewish people were eagerly waiting for a promised Rescuer called the "Christ" or "Messiah." Because John the Baptist was so powerful and popular, many people thought he was the one. His statement, "I am not the Christ," was a humble and crucial clarification, pointing everyone away from himself and toward the real Savior.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we can live with humility, choosing to make Jesus famous instead of ourselves. When we succeed or receive a compliment, we can use it as a chance to thank God and give Him the glory. Our lives should be a sign that points people to Jesus, not to us.
en.godsLove: God’s loving plan to save us was so detailed and personal that He sent a messenger first to prepare our hearts. He chose a humble man like John to announce the most important arrival in history. This shows that God's plan is not about human pride, but about His incredible love reaching out to us.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I be more like John, humbly pointing others to Jesus instead of seeking my own credit?

tl.understanding: Noong panahong iyon, sabik na naghihintay ang mga tao sa isang ipinangakong Tagapagligtas, ang "Kristo" o "Mesiyas." Dahil sikat at makapangyarihan ang ministeryo ni John the Baptist, inakala ng marami na siya na iyon. Ang kanyang pag-amin na "Hindi ako ang Kristo" ay isang mapagkumbaba at mahalagang paglilinaw para ituro ang lahat sa tunay na Tagapagligtas.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John, mamuhay tayo nang may kababaang-loob, na pinipiling si Hesus ang maging sikat at hindi tayo. Kapag tayo ay nagtatagumpay o nakakatanggap ng papuri, gamitin natin itong pagkakataon para pasalamatan ang Diyos at ibalik sa Kanya ang kaluwalhatian. Ang buhay natin ay dapat isang sign post na nakaturo kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili.
tl.godsLove: Ang mapagmahal na plano ng Diyos para iligtas tayo ay napakadetalyado at personal, kaya nagsugo muna Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang ating mga puso. Pinili Niya ang isang mapagkumbabang tao tulad ni John para ipahayag ang pinakamahalagang pagdating sa kasaysayan. Pinapakita nito na ang plano ng Diyos ay hindi tungkol sa kayabangan ng tao, kundi sa Kanyang dakilang pag-ibig para sa atin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako pwedeng maging mas katulad ni John—mapagkumbabang itinuturo ang iba kay Hesus sa halip na angkinin ang papuri para sa sarili?

en.understanding: People were asking John if he was the famous prophet Elijah, who was expected to return before the Messiah came. Even though John fulfilled that special role of preparing the way, he humbly denied being Elijah himself. His purpose wasn't to claim a famous title, but to point everyone to Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Like John, let's be clear about our role in God's story: we are here to point others to Jesus, not to ourselves. We don't need a fancy title or a big platform to be faithful. Our greatest work is simply making Jesus known in our own small way.
en.godsLove: God's beautiful plan doesn't rely on famous names, but on faithful hearts. He lovingly gives each of us a unique role, just as He gave one to John. We can find our greatest joy not in being the star, but in serving the One who truly is.
en.reflection:
In your daily life, how can you shift the spotlight from yourself and point it more clearly toward Jesus?

---
###

tl.understanding: Tinanong si John kung siya na ba ang sikat na propetang si Elijah, na inaasahang babalik bago dumating ang Mesiyas. Kahit ginampanan ni John ang mahalagang papel na iyon, mapagkumbaba niyang sinabi na hindi siya si Elijah. Ang layunin niya ay hindi para sa titulo, kundi para ituro ang lahat kay Hesus.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John, maging malinaw sana tayo sa ating papel sa kwento ng Diyos: ang ituro ang iba kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Hindi natin kailangan ng sikat na pangalan para maging tapat. Ang pinakamahalaga nating gawain ay ang ipakilala si Hesus sa ating sariling paraan.
tl.godsLove: Ang napakagandang plano ng Diyos ay hindi nakasalalay sa mga sikat na pangalan, kundi sa mga tapat na puso. Maingat Niyang binibigyan ang bawat isa sa atin ng kanya-kanyang papel, tulad ng ibinigay Niya kay John. Ang tunay na kagalakan ay wala sa pagiging bida, kundi sa paglilingkod sa tunay na Bida.
tl.reflection: Sa iyong pang-araw-araw na buhay, paano mo mas maibabaling ang atensyon mula sa iyong sarili patungo kay Hesus?

en.understanding: The question "Who are you?" is central to the whole Gospel of John. Just as they asked John the Baptist, Jesus' life and ministry would force everyone to ask the same question about Him. His identity would eventually divide people between those who believe in Him and those who don't.
en.livingItOut: We are all faced with the same question today: "Who is Jesus to me?" Answering this isn't just a one-time decision, but a daily choice to live in a way that proves He is our Lord. Let's make small choices today that show He is number one in our hearts.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and intentional that He sent messengers like John to prepare the way. He didn't want anyone to be confused, so He made the path to Jesus clear. This shows how much He longs for us to find Him and truly know who He is.
en.reflection: If someone asked you today, "Who is Jesus to you?", what would your honest answer be, and how does your life show it?

tl.understanding: Ang tanong na "Sino ka?" ay napakahalaga sa buong aklat ni Juan. Tulad ng pagtatanong nila kay Juan, ang buhay at ministeryo ni Hesus ay nag-uudyok sa lahat na tanungin din kung sino Siya. Ang pagkakakilanlan ni Hesus ang nagiging dahilan ng pagpili ng mga tao: maniniwala ba sila o hindi?
tl.livingItOut: Lahat tayo ay nahaharap sa parehong tanong ngayon: "Sino si Hesus para sa akin?" Ang pagsagot dito ay hindi lang minsanang desisyon, kundi isang pang-araw-araw na pagpili. Sa mga desisyon natin ngayon, ipakita nating Siya ang tunay na Panginoon natin.
tl.godsLove: Napakatiyaga at malinaw ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya nagpadala Siya ng mga mensahero tulad ni Juan para ihanda ang daan. Ayaw Niyang malito tayo, kaya tiniyak Niyang malinaw ang landas patungo kay Hesus. Pinapakita nito kung gaano Niya ninanais na makilala natin Siya nang lubusan.
tl.reflection: Kung may magtanong sa'yo ngayon, "Sino si Hesus para sa'yo?", ano ang magiging tapat mong sagot, at paano ito nakikita sa iyong pamumuhay?

en.understanding: Throughout the Gospel of John, Jesus’ teachings and miracles presented people with a choice. Some were drawn to Him and believed, while others hardened their hearts and opposed Him. This verse shows John the Baptist beginning this important work, preparing everyone for the decision they would have to make about Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Just like the people back then, we are also presented with a choice every day: will we follow Jesus or not? Let's choose to actively believe in Him, not just with our words, but through our actions of love and obedience. Our daily choices show who we truly follow.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and kind. He doesn't force us to follow Him, but He constantly invites us to believe through His Word and His work in our lives. This loving appeal to choose Him shows how much He desires a real relationship with us.
en.reflection: In what specific area of my life today can I more fully choose to believe and follow Jesus, instead of my own way?

tl.understanding: Sa buong aklat ng John, makikita natin na ang mga turo at himala ni Jesus ay nagbigay sa mga tao ng pagpipilian. May mga nanampalataya sa Kanya, at mayroon ding tumutol at tumalikod. Ipinapakita sa talatang ito na si John the Baptist ang nagsimula ng daan para ihanda ang lahat sa pagpiling gagawin nila tungkol kay Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga tao noon, tayo rin ay may pagpipilian araw-araw: susunod ba tayo kay Jesus o hindi? Piliin nating manampalataya sa Kanya, hindi lang sa salita, kundi sa ating mga gawa ng pagmamahal at pagsunod. Ang ating mga desisyon sa araw-araw ang nagpapakita kung sino talaga ang sinusunod natin.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti at mapagpasensya ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya tayo pinipilit na sumunod, ngunit patuloy Niya tayong inaanyayahang maniwala sa pamamagitan ng Kanyang Salita at pagkilos sa buhay natin. Ang paanyayang ito na piliin Siya ay nagpapakita kung gaano Niya nais na magkaroon tayo ng tunay na relasyon sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ngayon ako mas lubos na makakapili na maniwala at sumunod kay Jesus, sa halip na sa sarili kong paraan?

en.understanding: It's easy to see the Pharisees as just the 'bad guys,' but this verse reminds us they were very religious. They knew the Scriptures well and were seriously looking for the promised Messiah. This is why they were sent to investigate what John the Baptist was doing.
en.livingItOut: This is a good reminder that knowing a lot about the Bible isn't enough on its own. Let's ask God to give us a soft heart that's open to His work, even when it looks different from what we expect. Our goal is a relationship with Jesus, not just information about Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and wide that it reaches everyone, even those who might seem far from Him. He pursued and transformed some of these very Pharisees, like the apostle Paul, proving that no one is beyond the reach of His grace.
en.reflection: In what area of my life is God inviting me to have a more open and teachable heart, instead of just relying on what I already know?

tl.understanding: Madaling isipin na ang mga Pariseo ay 'yung mga kontrabida lang sa Bible, pero sila ay mga taong seryoso sa kanilang pananampalataya. Masisigasig silang nag-aaral ng Salita ng Diyos at talagang inaabangan nila ang pagdating ng Mesiyas, kaya sila sinugo para mag-imbestiga.
tl.livingItOut: Paalala ito sa atin na hindi sapat ang kaalaman lang sa Bibliya. Idalangin natin na bigyan tayo ng pusong bukas at handang tumanggap sa ginagawa ng Diyos, kahit na iba ito sa ating inaasahan. Ang mahalaga ay ang relasyon natin sa Kanya, hindi lang ang impormasyon tungkol sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakatiyaga at napakalawak ng pag-ibig ng Diyos, abot kahit ang mga taong tila malayo sa Kanya. Hinabol at binago Niya ang ilan sa mga Pariseo, tulad ni Apostol Pablo, na patunay na walang sinuman ang hindi kayang abutin ng Kanyang biyaya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako inaanyayahan ng Diyos na maging mas bukas at handang matuto sa Kanya, sa halip na umasa lang sa aking mga nalalaman?

en.understanding: This questioning of John the Baptist shows an important theme we see throughout the Gospel of John. Just as people were divided in their response to Jesus, we see here that even John's ministry caused people to question and choose sides. This was the beginning of a great sifting of what was truly in people's hearts.
en.livingItOut: Let's be careful not to put God in a box based on our own expectations. We can ask God to give us open hearts to see His work around us, even when it looks different than we imagined. Be open to how He might be moving in your life today in an unexpected way.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and thoughtful. He didn't just send Jesus unannounced; He first sent a messenger, John, to prepare people's hearts to receive the greatest gift. This shows His deep desire for us to be ready to meet His Son.
en.reflection: Is there any area in my life where my own expectations might be blinding me to what God is actually trying to do?

tl.understanding: Pinapakita ng pagtatanong na ito kay John the Baptist ang isang mahalagang tema sa buong aklat ni John. Tulad ng mga tao na nahati ang opinyon tungkol kay Jesus, makikita natin dito na maging ang ministeryo ni John ay nag-udyok sa mga tao na magtanong at mamili ng panig. Ito ang simula ng pagsala sa kung ano talaga ang nasa puso ng bawat isa.
tl.livingItOut: Ingatan natin na huwag "ikahon" ang Diyos ayon lang sa ating mga inaasahan. Hilingin natin sa Kanya ang isang bukas na puso para makita ang Kanyang pagkilos sa paligid natin, kahit pa iba ito sa ating inaakala. Maging bukas ka sa mga hindi inaasahang paraan ng pagkilos Niya sa buhay mo ngayon.
tl.godsLove: Napakatiyaga at maalalahanin ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya basta na lang ipinadala si Jesus; nagsugo muna Siya ng isang mensahero, si John, upang ihanda ang puso ng mga tao na tanggapin ang pinakadakilang regalo. Pinapakita nito ang Kanyang matinding pagnanais na maging handa tayong lahat na salubungin ang Kanyang Anak.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bahagi sa buhay ko kung saan ang sarili kong mga inaasahan ang nagiging dahilan para hindi ko makita ang totoong ginagawa ng Diyos?

en.understanding: In John the Baptist's time, untying someone's sandals was the most humble job, reserved only for a slave. John is saying that compared to Jesus, he doesn't even feel worthy enough to do the lowest possible task for Him. This shows how incredibly great and holy John knew Jesus was.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we can live a life that points to Jesus, not to ourselves. In our successes, we can choose to give Him the glory, and in our service, we can do it humbly for Him, not for recognition. Let's make it our goal to make Jesus famous in everything we do.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that this same Jesus, who is so great that John felt unworthy to touch His sandals, humbled Himself to come to earth for us? He is worthy of all praise, yet He lovingly chose to serve us, even to the point of dying on the cross. His greatness makes His love for us even more incredible.
en.reflection: In what area of your life today can you make Jesus bigger and yourself smaller?

tl.understanding: Noong panahon ni John the Baptist, ang pagtanggal ng sandalyas ay trabaho ng isang alipin—ang pinakamababang gawain. Sinasabi ni John na hindi man lang siya karapat-dapat gawin ang pinakamababang trabaho para kay Hesus. Ipinapakita nito kung gaano kadakila at kabanal si Hesus sa kanyang paningin.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John, mamuhay tayo sa paraan na nagtuturo sa mga tao patungo kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Sa ating mga tagumpay, piliin nating ibigay sa Kanya ang papuri, at sa ating paglilingkod, gawin natin ito nang may kababaang-loob para sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ba't kamangha-mangha na itong si Hesus, na sobrang dakila at hindi man lang naramdamang karapat-dapat si John na hawakan ang Kanyang sandalyas, ay nagpakumbaba para sa atin? Siya na karapat-dapat sa lahat ng papuri ay mapagmahal na piniling paglingkuran tayo hanggang sa kamatayan sa krus.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon mo pwedeng mas itaas si Hesus at ibaba ang iyong sarili?

en.understanding: When John the Baptist called Jesus the "Lamb of God," the people knew exactly what he meant. In the Old Testament, a lamb was sacrificed during Passover to save God's people, and lambs were also offered daily for sins. John was declaring that Jesus is the ultimate, perfect sacrifice who came to save us all.
en.livingItOut: Because Jesus is our Lamb, we don't have to carry the heavy weight of guilt and shame from our past mistakes. We can confidently bring our failures to Him, knowing He has already paid the price for our complete forgiveness. Let’s walk in the freedom He won for us today!
en.godsLove: God's love is so amazing that He provided the solution for our sin Himself. He didn't wait for us to clean up our act; instead, He sent His own Son to be the perfect Lamb. This was His loving plan from the very beginning to bring us back into His arms.
en.reflection: Is there any guilt or shame you are still carrying that you can surrender to Jesus, the Lamb of God, today?

tl.understanding: Nang tinawag ni John the Baptist si Jesus na "Kordero ng Diyos," naintindihan agad ng mga tao ang ibig niyang sabihin. Sa Old Testament, ang tupa (lamb) ang isinasakripisyo para sa kapatawaran ng kasalanan, lalo na tuwing Passover. Ipinapahayag ni John na si Jesus ang pinaka-perpektong sakripisyo para iligtas tayong lahat.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Jesus ang ating Kordero, hindi na natin kailangang pasanin pa ang bigat ng ating mga pagkakamali at kahihiyan. Pwede nating ilapit sa Kanya ang ating mga kasalanan nang may tiwala, dahil alam nating bayad na Niya ang lahat. Mamuhay tayo sa kalayaang ipinanalo Niya para sa atin!
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil Siya mismo ang gumawa ng paraan para sa ating kasalanan. Hindi Niya hinintay na ayusin muna natin ang ating sarili; sa halip, isinugo Niya ang Kanyang Anak bilang perpektong Kordero. Ito ang Kanyang mapagmahal na plano mula't sapul para maibalik tayo sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bigat ng kasalanan o kahihiyan na pasan mo pa rin hanggang ngayon na maaari mong isuko kay Jesus, ang Kordero ng Diyos?

en.understanding: This is John the Baptist showing amazing humility. He's saying that even though his ministry started first, Jesus is infinitely greater because He existed long before him. John’s whole mission was to point people to Jesus, not to himself.
en.livingItOut: We can follow John's example by making our lives point to Jesus, not to us. In our work, our family, and even on social media, we can choose to decrease so that Christ can increase in the eyes of others. Let your actions and words build up Jesus' name, not your own.
en.godsLove: God's loving plan for our salvation was so detailed that He sent a messenger ahead to prepare our hearts for Jesus. He doesn't force Himself on us; He lovingly prepares the way and invites us to know His Son. This shows His incredible care and desire for you to come to Him.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God asking you to step back so that His glory can shine through you more brightly?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita dito ni John the Baptist ang kanyang napakagandang pagpapakumbaba. Kahit nauna ang kanyang ministeryo, sinasabi niyang mas dakila si Jesus dahil si Jesus ay nariyan na bago pa man siya isilang. Ang buong misyon ni John ay ituro ang mga tao kay Jesus, hindi sa kanyang sarili.
tl.livingItOut: Pwede nating tularan ang halimbawa ni John sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng ating buhay na nakaturo kay Jesus, hindi sa atin. Sa ating trabaho, pamilya, at kahit sa social media, piliin nating tayo ang "mag-step back" para si Kristo ang mas makilala ng iba. Hayaan mong ang iyong gawa at salita ay magbigay papuri sa pangalan ni Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Napakadetalyado ng plano ng Diyos para sa ating kaligtasan, kaya nagpadala pa Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang mga puso natin para kay Jesus. Hindi Niya ipinipilit ang Kanyang sarili; sa halip, buong pagmamahal Niyang inihahanda ang daan at inaanyayahan tayong makilala ang Kanyang Anak.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ka tinatawag ng Diyos na "mag-step back" para mas lalong magniningning ang Kanyang kaluwalhatian sa pamamagitan mo?

en.understanding: John the Baptist is explaining his life's purpose. His popular ministry of baptizing wasn't for his own fame, but to prepare people's hearts and point everyone's attention to Jesus. He was like the opening act, making sure the crowd was ready for the main star, Jesus Christ.
en.livingItOut: Just like John, our lives can be a signpost that points to Jesus. In our work, our family, and our friendships, let's aim to decrease so that He can increase. Our goal isn't to get praise for ourselves, but for others to see Jesus' goodness through us.
en.godsLove: God's love is so thoughtful and detailed. He didn't just send Jesus unannounced; He lovingly sent a messenger first to prepare the way and make sure people were ready to receive Him. This shows God always has a careful, loving plan to draw us to Himself.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I step back a little, so that Jesus can be seen more clearly through my words and actions?

tl.understanding: Ipinaliliwanag dito ni Juan Bautista ang misyon ng buhay niya. Ang kanyang pagbabautismo ay hindi para sa sarili niyang kasikatan, kundi para ihanda ang puso ng mga tao at ituro sila kay Hesus. Para siyang isang "front act" na sinisigurong handa na ang lahat para sa pagdating ng Panginoon.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Juan, ang buhay natin ay pwedeng maging tulay para makilala ng iba si Hesus. Sa ating trabaho, pamilya, at sa mga kaibigan, sikapin nating tayo ang magpakumbaba para si Kristo ang maiangat. Ang layunin natin ay hindi ang papuri para sa sarili, kundi ang makita ng iba ang kabutihan ni Hesus sa pamamagitan natin.
tl.godsLove: Napakamaalalahanin ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya basta na lang isinugo si Hesus; buong pagmamahal Siyang nagpadala muna ng mensahero para ihanda ang daan. Pinapakita nito na laging may maingat at mapagmahal na plano ang Diyos para ilapit tayo sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako pwedeng mag-step back nang kaunti, para mas makita si Hesus sa aking mga salita at gawa?

en.understanding: In the past, the Holy Spirit's anointing on prophets and kings was often temporary. But for Jesus, the Spirit didn't just visit; He came to "rest" and stay permanently. This showed that Jesus' anointing and authority were unique and without end.
en.livingItOut: Because of Jesus, the Holy Spirit now lives inside every believer permanently, not just for special moments. We can live with confidence today, knowing we can depend on His constant guidance and strength in everything we do.
en.godsLove: This beautiful moment reveals the Father's deep love and complete approval of His Son, Jesus. God publicly marked Jesus as the special One, fully equipped by His Spirit to begin the mission to save us all.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life do you need to more fully trust the Holy Spirit's permanent presence and guidance with you today?

tl.understanding: Dati, ang presensya ng Banal na Espiritu sa mga propeta at hari ay madalas pansamantala lang. Pero kay Hesus, hindi lang Siya dinalaw ng Espiritu; ito ay "nanatili" sa Kanya habang-buhay. Ipinapakita nito na ang kapangyarihan at awtoridad ni Hesus ay kakaiba at walang katapusan.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil kay Hesus, ang Banal na Espiritu ay nananahan na rin sa bawat mananampalataya nang permanente, hindi lang para sa mga espesyal na pagkakataon. Pwede tayong mamuhay nang may kumpiyansa, dahil alam nating maaasahan natin ang Kanyang tuluy-tuloy na gabay at lakas sa lahat ng ating ginagawa.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita ng magandang sandaling ito ang malalim na pag-ibig at buong-pusong pagsang-ayon ng Ama sa Kanyang Anak na si Hesus. Hayagang tinatakan ng Diyos si Hesus bilang Siyang natatangi, na lubos na sinangkapan ng Espiritu para simulan ang misyon na iligtas tayong lahat.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular na bahagi ng iyong buhay ngayon kailangan mong mas lubos na pagtiwalaan ang permanenteng presensya at gabay ng Banal na Espiritu?

en.understanding: This verse shows the special job God gave to John the Baptist: to point everyone to Jesus. God gave John a clear sign—the Holy Spirit coming down—so he would know for sure who Jesus was. John's whole purpose was to make Jesus famous, not himself.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our lives can be a sign that points others to Jesus. In everything we do, whether at work or with family, let's ask ourselves how we can make Him more known. The goal is for people to see less of us and more of Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so detailed and caring that He didn't want anyone to be confused about who Jesus was. He gave John a specific sign so there would be no doubt, making sure the way to His Son was clear for all of us. He always makes a way for us to find Him.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I step back, so that others can more clearly see Jesus through me?

tl.understanding: Pinapakita dito ang special na trabaho na binigay ng Diyos kay John the Baptist: ang ituro ang lahat ng tao kay Hesus. Binigyan pa siya ng Diyos ng malinaw na sign—ang pagbaba ng Espiritu Santo—para sigurado siyang si Hesus nga ang Tagapagligtas. Ang buong layunin ni John ay para sumikat si Hesus, hindi siya.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John the Baptist, ang buhay natin ay pwedeng maging isang sign na nagtuturo sa iba papunta kay Hesus. Sa lahat ng ginagawa natin, sa trabaho man o sa pamilya, tanungin natin ang sarili kung paano natin Siya mas maipapakilala. Ang goal ay mas makita ng tao si Hesus at hindi tayo.
tl.godsLove: Napakadetalyado at mapagmahal ng Diyos; ayaw Niyang malito ang mga tao kung sino ba talaga si Hesus. Binigyan Niya si John ng specific na sign para walang duda, at para siguraduhing malinaw sa ating lahat ang daan papunta sa Kanyang Anak. Palagi Siyang gumagawa ng paraan para mahanap natin Siya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako pwedeng 'um-atras' nang kaunti, para mas malinaw na makita ng iba si Hesus sa pamamagitan ko?

en.understanding: When John the Baptist called Jesus the "Son of God," he was also declaring Him as the "Chosen One" that God had promised long ago in the book of Isaiah. This wasn't just a random title, but a powerful confirmation that Jesus is the long-awaited Savior God's people were waiting for.
en.livingItOut: Just like John, we are called to be witnesses for Jesus. You can do this by sharing your personal story of how He has worked in your life, even in the small things. Your testimony has the power to point others to Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so faithful that He kept a promise He made centuries before. He didn't leave us without hope but sent His very own Chosen One, Jesus, to rescue us. This was His ultimate plan of love for you and me.
en.reflection: What is one way you have seen Jesus at work in your life, and who is one person you can share that story with this week?

tl.understanding: Nang tawagin ni Juan si Hesus na "Anak ng Diyos," ipinapahayag din niya na si Hesus ang "Hinirang" na ipinangako ng Diyos noon pa sa aklat ni Isaias. Hindi lang ito basta titulo; ito ay kumpirmasyon na si Hesus na nga ang matagal nang hinihintay na Tagapagligtas.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista, tinawag din tayong maging mga saksi ni Hesus. Ibahagi mo ang personal mong kwento kung paano Siya kumilos sa buhay mo, kahit sa mga simpleng paraan. Ang patotoo mo ay may kapangyarihang magturo sa iba patungo sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil tinupad Niya ang pangakong binitiwan Niya maraming siglo na ang nakalipas. Hindi Niya tayo iniwang mag-isa, kundi isinugo Niya ang Kanyang sariling Hinirang, si Hesus, para sagipin tayo. Ito ang Kanyang dakilang plano ng pag-ibig para sa iyo at sa akin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong paraan mo personal na nakita ang pagkilos ni Hesus sa buhay mo, at sino ang isang tao na maaari mong bahaginan ng kwentong iyon ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse shows the incredible humility of John the Baptist. His whole mission was not to gather followers for himself, but to prepare them to meet and follow Jesus. We see here the moment his ministry starts to transition to Jesus, fulfilling his very purpose.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our greatest success is when we point others to Jesus, not to ourselves. In our conversations and actions today, let's aim to make Jesus famous instead of trying to build our own reputation. Let Him increase while we decrease.
en.godsLove: God's love is so intentional; He doesn't leave us to find our way alone. He lovingly prepared the way for us to meet Jesus by sending a guide like John the Baptist. This shows us that God always makes the first move to draw us closer to Him.
en.reflection: In what area of my life do I need to "decrease" so that Jesus can "increase" and receive more glory?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang kababaang-loob ni John the Baptist. Ang misyon niya ay hindi ang magparami ng sarili niyang tagasunod, kundi ang ihanda ang mga tao para makilala at sundan si Jesus. Dito natin nakikita ang simula ng paglilipat ng ministeryo mula sa kanya patungo kay Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John the Baptist, ang pinakadakila nating tagumpay ay kapag naituturo natin ang iba kay Jesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Sa ating mga salita at gawa ngayon, sikapin nating si Jesus ang maging bida at hindi ang ating reputasyon. Hayaan natin Siyang lumago habang tayo ay nagpapakumbaba.
tl.godsLove: Ganito ka-determinado ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi Niya tayo hinahayaang mag-isa sa paghahanap sa Kanya. Buong pagmamahal Niyang inihanda ang daan para makilala natin si Jesus sa pamamagitan ng mga gabay tulad ni John. Ipinapakita nito na ang Diyos ang laging unang gumagawa ng paraan para mapalapit tayo sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako kailangang magpakumbaba para si Jesus naman ang maitaas at tumanggap ng papuri?

en.understanding: John the Baptist's great mission wasn't to gather followers for himself, but to point everyone to Jesus. When he identified Jesus as the "Lamb of God," his own disciples understood it was time to follow the one he was pointing to. John’s success was measured by how many people looked away from him and toward Christ.
en.livingItOut: Like John, our greatest success is not when people are impressed with us, but when they are impressed with Jesus because of us. In our work, family, and friendships, let's use our words and actions to make Jesus famous, not ourselves. Our lives should be a signpost pointing to Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He uses people to introduce us to His Son. He set up a beautiful plan, using a humble servant like John to make sure we wouldn't miss the most important person in history. He lovingly makes a way for us to find Jesus.
en.reflection: In my conversations and actions this week, how can I lovingly shift the spotlight from myself to Jesus?

tl.understanding: Ang dakilang misyon ni John the Baptist ay hindi para mag-ipon ng followers para sa sarili niya, kundi para ituro ang lahat kay Hesus. Nang sinabi niyang si Hesus ang "Kordero ng Diyos," naintindihan ng mga disipulo niya na oras na para sumunod sa itinuturo niya. Ang tagumpay ni John ay nasusukat sa kung gaano karami ang tumingin kay Kristo dahil sa kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John, ang tunay nating tagumpay ay hindi kapag humahanga ang mga tao sa atin, kundi kapag humahanga sila kay Hesus dahil sa atin. Sa ating trabaho, pamilya, at mga kaibigan, gamitin natin ang ating mga salita at gawa para si Hesus ang sumikat, hindi tayo.
tl.godsLove: Ganito ka-personal ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; gumagamit Siya ng mga tao para ipakilala sa atin ang Kanyang Anak. Gumawa Siya ng napakagandang plano, gamit ang isang lingkod tulad ni John, para masigurong makikilala natin ang pinaka-importanteng tao sa kasaysayan. Puno ng pagmamahal Siyang gumagawa ng paraan para matagpuan natin si Hesus.
tl.reflection: Sa aking mga pakikipag-usap at pagkilos ngayong linggo, paano ko maibabaling ang atensyon mula sa aking sarili patungo kay Hesus sa isang paraang puno ng pagmamahal?

en.understanding: John the Baptist's whole purpose was to point people to Jesus. When his own disciples heard him identify Jesus as the Lamb of God, they immediately understood his message. This wasn't a betrayal; it was the very goal of John's ministry coming true!
en.livingItOut: Like John, our role is to introduce people to Jesus, not to gather followers for ourselves. Let's aim to point others so clearly to Him that they begin their own walk with Jesus. Our greatest success is when people’s faith is in Christ, not in us.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He uses people in our lives to point us to Jesus. He doesn't hide Himself but sends faithful messengers to guide us. The Father's heart is always calling us to come closer to His Son, Jesus.
en.reflection: Who was the "John the Baptist" in your life who first pointed you to Jesus, and how can you be that person for someone else this week?

tl.understanding: Ang buong misyon ni John the Baptist ay ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus. Nang marinig ng sarili niyang mga alagad na si Hesus ang Kordero ng Diyos, agad silang sumunod sa Kanya. Hindi ito pagtataksil; ito mismo ang tagumpay ng ministeryo ni John!
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John, ang ating papel ay ipakilala ang mga tao kay Hesus, hindi para magkaroon ng sarili nating followers. Layunin nating ituro sila nang malinaw kay Hesus para magsimula silang maglakad kasama Niya. Ang tunay na tagumpay ay kapag ang pananampalataya nila ay nakatuon kay Kristo, hindi sa atin.
tl.godsLove: Personal ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; gumagamit Siya ng mga tao sa buhay natin para ituro tayo kay Hesus. Hindi Siya nagtatago, kundi nagpapadala Siya ng mga tapat na mensahero para gabayan tayo. Laging bukas ang puso ng Ama na tawagin tayong lumapit sa Kanyang Anak.
tl.reflection: Sino ang naging "John the Baptist" sa buhay mo na unang nagturo sa iyo patungkol kay Hesus, at paano ka naman pwedeng maging tulad niya para sa iba ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse marks a very important moment. John the Baptist's whole purpose was to point people to Jesus, and now we see his own disciples making that switch. They are leaving their old teacher to follow the One he was talking about all along.
en.livingItOut: Like these first disciples, our faith shouldn't just be about listening to sermons or reading the Bible. We are called to take a step and actively follow Jesus in our daily decisions. It’s about moving from just knowing *about* Him to actually walking *with* Him.
en.godsLove: Notice Jesus' gentle response when He sees them following. He doesn't ignore them; He turns and invites them into a conversation. This shows God’s loving heart—He is always ready to welcome us the moment we take a step toward Him, no matter how small.
en.reflection: If Jesus turned to you today and asked, “What do you want?”, what would your honest answer be?

tl.understanding: Napakahalaga ng sandaling ito. Ang tanging layunin ni John the Baptist ay ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus, at ngayon, nakikita natin na mismong mga disipulo niya ay nagsisimula nang sumunod sa Kanya. Ito ang simula ng paglipat ng kanilang atensyon mula kay John patungo kay Kristo.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga unang disipulo, ang ating pananampalataya ay hindi lang dapat tungkol sa pakikinig. Tinatawag din tayong humakbang at aktibong sumunod kay Hesus sa ating mga desisyon araw-araw. Higit pa ito sa pag-alam lang tungkol sa Kanya; ito ay tungkol sa personal na pagsama sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Pansinin ang magiliw na tugon ni Hesus nang makita Niya silang sumusunod. Hindi Niya sila binalewala; lumingon Siya at inanyayahan silang makipag-usap. Pinapakita nito ang mapagmahal na puso ng Diyos—lagi Siyang handang tanggapin tayo sa sandaling humakbang tayo palapit sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Kung lilingunin ka ni Hesus ngayon at tatanungin, “Ano ang hinahanap mo?”, ano ang magiging tapat na sagot ng puso mo?

en.understanding: This verse shows John the Baptist’s mission succeeding. His whole purpose was to point people to Jesus. Now, his own disciples are leaving him to follow the very person he was preparing them for.
en.livingItOut: Jesus' invitation to "come and see" is also for us today. Let's not just learn *about* Him, but personally spend time with Him through prayer and reading His Word. This is how we truly get to know Him.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that Jesus' first response is a personal invitation? He doesn't just give us information; He invites us into a relationship to spend time with Him. God's love is relational, and He desires for you to come close.
en.reflection: What is one practical way you can accept Jesus’ invitation to "come and see" and spend quality time with Him this week?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang tagumpay ng misyon ni John the Baptist. Ang tanging layunin niya ay ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus. Ngayon, ang sarili niyang mga alagad ay sinusundan na ang mismong taong ipinakilala niya sa kanila.
tl.livingItOut: Ang imbitasyon ni Hesus na "halikayo at tingnan" ay para din sa atin ngayon. Huwag lang tayong mag-aral *tungkol* sa Kanya; gumugol tayo ng personal na oras kasama Siya sa panalangin at pagbabasa ng Salita Niya. Dito natin Siya tunay na makikilala.
tl.godsLove: Nakakatuwang isipin na ang unang tugon ni Hesus ay isang personal na imbitasyon. Hindi lang Siya nagbibigay ng impormasyon; inaanyayahan Niya tayong makipag-relasyon at makasama Siya. Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay relasyonal, at nais Niyang mapalapit ka sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Ano ang isang praktikal na paraan para matanggap mo ang imbitasyon ni Hesus na "halikayo at tingnan" at makasama Siya nang personal ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse shows John the Baptist's mission in action. His purpose wasn't to gather followers for himself, but to point them directly to Jesus. When his own disciples, like Andrew, heard his testimony, they did exactly that—they left John and started following the Lamb of God.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our lives should be a signpost pointing others to Jesus, not to ourselves. In our conversations, work, and service, let's aim to make Jesus famous. We can be happy when He gets the credit and we fade into the background.
en.godsLove: God's loving plan unfolds beautifully here, using one faithful person to lead others to His Son. He doesn't ask us to be the savior, but simply to be faithful messengers who introduce people to the One who is. This reveals a God who invites us to be part of His amazing story.
en.reflection: In what small way this week can you direct someone's attention away from yourself and towards the goodness of Jesus?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang totoong misyon ni John the Baptist. Ang layunin niya ay hindi para magkaroon ng sariling followers, kundi para ituro ang mga tao diretso kay Hesus. Nang marinig ng disipulo niyang si Andrew ang kanyang patotoo, agad siyang umalis at sumunod sa Kordero ng Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John the Baptist, sana ang buhay natin ay maging tulad ng isang karatula na nagtuturo sa iba papunta kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Sa ating mga usapan, trabaho, at paglilingkod, layunin nating si Hesus ang maging bida. Maging masaya tayo kapag Siya ang nabibigyan ng papuri.
tl.godsLove: Napakaganda ng plano ng Diyos na puno ng pag-ibig—gumagamit Siya ng isang tapat na tao para akayin ang iba patungo sa Kanyang Anak. Hindi Niya hinihiling na tayo ang maging tagapagligtas, kundi maging tapat lang na tagapagdala ng mensahe tungkol sa Kanya. Nagpapakita ito ng isang Diyos na inaanyayahan tayong maging bahagi ng Kanyang dakilang kwento.
tl.reflection: Sa anong maliit na paraan ngayong linggo mo maaaring ituro ang atensyon ng isang tao mula sa iyong sarili patungo sa kabutihan ni Hesus?

en.understanding: Andrew was one of John the Baptist's followers. John's main job was to point people to Jesus, and Andrew clearly got the message! The moment Andrew met Jesus, he knew he had found the promised Messiah and couldn't keep it to himself.
en.livingItOut: Like Andrew, our first instinct after a powerful encounter with Jesus should be to share Him with those closest to us. Don't overthink it; just share your simple, excited discovery with a family member or a close friend this week.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He often uses the people we know and trust to bring us His good news. He loves families, and He delights in seeing His message of hope spread from one heart to another, starting with those we love most.
en.reflection: Who is the first person God is putting on your heart to share the good news of Jesus with?

tl.understanding: Si Andrew ay isa sa mga tagasunod ni John the Baptist. Ang tanging layunin ni John ay ituro sa mga tao kung sino si Hesus, at nakuha ito agad ni Andrew! Sa sandaling makilala niya si Hesus, alam niyang natagpuan na niya ang ipinangakong Mesiyas.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Andrew, ang una sana nating reaksyon matapos makilala nang lubos si Hesus ay ang ibahagi Siya sa mga taong pinakamalapit sa atin. Huwag mo nang masyadong isipin; i-share mo lang ang iyong simpleng kagalakan sa isang kapamilya o kaibigan ngayong linggo.
tl.godsLove: Napakapersonal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; madalas Niyang ginagamit ang mga taong kilala at pinagkakatiwalaan natin para ihatid ang Magandang Balita. Mahal Niya ang mga pamilya, at nagagalak Siyang makita na ang Kanyang mensahe ng pag-asa ay kumakalat mula sa isang puso patungo sa isa pa.
tl.reflection: Sino ang unang taong inilalagay ng Diyos sa puso mo para bahaginan ng Magandang Balita tungkol kay Hesus?

en.understanding: This moment is part of a beautiful chain reaction started by John the Baptist. After John pointed him to Jesus, Andrew's first instinct was to bring his own brother, Simon, to meet the Messiah. It shows how the mission of introducing people to Jesus was immediately passed on from one person to the next.
en.livingItOut: Like Andrew, we can be connectors who introduce our family and friends to Jesus. We don't need to have all the answers; our most important job is simply to bring them to Him. Let's pray for one person this week whom we can invite into a conversation about faith.
en.godsLove: God's loving plan doesn't just rely on famous prophets; He delights in using everyday people like you and me. He lovingly invites us to participate in His work of reaching others. It shows how much He values our simple acts of sharing His goodness.
en.reflection: Who is the "Simon Peter" in your life that God is prompting you to introduce to Jesus?

tl.understanding: Ang eksenang ito ay bahagi ng isang magandang "chain reaction" na sinimulan ni John the Baptist. Matapos ituro ni Juan si Hesus sa kanya, ang unang ginawa ni Andres ay isama agad ang kapatid niyang si Simon. Pinapakita nito kung paano naipasa agad ang misyon ng pagpapakilala kay Hesus sa iba.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Andres, pwede tayong maging tulay para makilala ng pamilya at mga kaibigan natin si Hesus. Hindi kailangan na alam natin ang lahat ng sagot; ang mahalaga ay dalhin natin sila sa Kanya. Ipanalangin natin ang isang tao ngayong linggo na pwede nating ayain na mag-usap tungkol kay Lord.
tl.godsLove: Ang mapagmahal na plano ng Diyos ay hindi lang umaasa sa mga sikat na propeta; nagagalak Siyang gamitin ang mga ordinaryong taong tulad natin.
